feature.label: OUT NOW
feature.headline: Dandy's World Finally Leaves Alpha
feature.dek: Two years of alpha, one new mode, more than 10 new floors, and a lot of reading.
paras: BlushCrunch Studio's horror hit Dandy's World went 1.0 on Friday, November 20, after more than two years in alpha. The headline feature is the Labs, the game's first new mode, with more than 10 new floors deep inside Gardenview Center, two new Lethal Toons called Desa and D, and a new currency, Ambrosia, spent on cards.

There are also more than 30 new achievements and nearly 15,000 words of new lore and dialogue. The game has passed 7.9 billion visits, and the 1.0 Release event runs until November 30. The Twisteds have reportedly been taught to think. Good luck.

stories.headline: GTA VI Is Out. Roblox Saw It Coming.
stories.dek: Roblox's forecast already counted on a small hit. Then a turkey pulled 6.9 million players.
paras: Take-Two released Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19. Back in October, Roblox guided for fourth-quarter bookings of $1.89 billion to $2.00 billion, a 10% to 15% drop from a year earlier, and that guide already includes a modest hit from GTA's release, Trefis notes.

The stock fell 7.6% on November 16 and 4.6% on November 17, then jumped 7.6% on November 18 with no news from Roblox at all. Two days after GTA VI arrived, Steal An Egg pulled 6.9 million players at once. Roblox players appear to be busy.

stories.headline: ARK Sells Another Slice Of Roblox
stories.dek: 161,616 shares out the door on Friday. That's a lot of studs.
paras: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest sold 161,616 Roblox shares from its ARK Next Generation Internet ETF on Friday, November 20, worth about $7.6 million at that day's $46.72 close, per ARK's daily trade email as reported by TIKR.

ARK had already cut its Roblox stake by 79% in the quarter ending September 30, leaving 1.38 million shares worth $58 million. Analysts' average price target has dropped from $146 a year ago to $50 today.

stories.headline: Steal An Egg Makes $40M+ In Three Months
stories.dek: Turns out watching ads to hatch eggs faster is a business model.
paras: Roblox's biggest game of the year has brought in more than $40 million from in-game purchases and advertising over the past three months, Bloomberg reports. Players can watch ads to hatch their eggs faster, and that's exactly the kind of game Roblox wants for its growing ads business.
It averaged 1,341,295 players in October, down 26% on September, and then its Turkey Takeover update pulled a peak of 6,903,927 on November 21. The turkey is now the most valuable bird in gaming.

stories.headline: Analysts Lower Their Hopes
stories.dek: Targets now run from $33 to $80. The average is $50.
paras: After earnings, several banks changed their targets for the stock. Jefferies cut its target to $35 (from $38), JPMorgan to $46 (from $53) and Citi to $55 (from $60). Bank of America went the other way on November 19, nudging its target up to $48 from $45 and keeping a Neutral rating.
Across Wall Street, targets now run from $33 to $80, with an average of $50, about 8% above Friday's close. In plain words: the grown-ups are nervous, the kids are still playing.

dealStories.headline: Tower Defense Simulator Teams Up With doBIG
dealStories.dek: A partnership, not a sale. The community still had feelings.
paras: Do Big Studios (doBIG), the company behind Blade Ball and many other hits, announced a partnership with Paradoxum Games, the studio that makes Tower Defense Simulator. TDS creator BelowNatural confirmed it is a partnership, not a full sale of the game. The price wasn't shared.

How much is TDS worth? **Our estimate: around $60 million.** Here's the math: in a 2026 lawsuit, a former co-developer asked for $25 million for what he says is a 40% share of the game. If 40% is worth $25M, the whole game would be about $60M. That's one side's claim in a lawsuit, so treat it as a rough guess.

up.headline: Steal An Egg Gets Turkey-Stuffed
up.dek: The Turkey Takeover update took the game from about 1 million to 6.9 million at once.
paras: Steal An Egg's Update 14, Turkey Takeover, went live on November 21 at 15:00 UTC. That day the game peaked at 6,903,927 players at once, almost seven times Friday's peak of 1,007,779. Its all-time record is still 12,443,225, set on October 3.

A giant turkey called King Gobble attacks every 30 minutes, players chase it down for Feathers, and the prizes include a Golden Turkey and a Divine King Gobble. The event runs until November 27. Thanksgiving has never been this competitive.

up.headline: Throw a Seed Grows Like A Weed
up.dek: Born November 7. Already #23 on Roblox's all-time record list.
paras: Throw a Seed by Fish Time Studios came out on November 7 and has already hit a record of 173,000 players at once, good for #23 on RBLXSTAT's list of the highest player records ever measured. It had 36,188 playing when the list was updated on November 21.
It's not alone: Shoot Arrows For Animals! (NEW+1 Games Club, made Nov 5) hit 85,300. Roblox has officially entered its throwing-things-at-animals era, and the animals have entered their dodging era.

up.headline: Someone Is Selling Christmas Trees Already
up.dek: It is November. The tree lot is open. 73,400 people showed up.
paras: Run a Christmas Tree Lot by Mr. Grinchmas, made on November 4, has hit a record of 73,400 players at once and had 12,785 playing on November 21, per RBLXSTAT.
Yes, the developer is called Mr. Grinchmas. Yes, he is selling Christmas trees. We are choosing not to ask questions.

up.headline: Krillion Gives Weird Answers, Gets Players
up.dek: A party game about strange answers hits a new high of 10,954.
paras: Krillion by Hypr Games set a new all-time high of 10,954 players at once on November 21, with its daily average up 47% on the day before, per RBLXSTAT. It has 2,910,167 visits.
Players answer questions in the strangest way they can, in public lobbies or private parties. Only 62% of voters like it, which for a game about bad answers feels on brand.

down.headline: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape Runs Out Of Keys
down.dek: Once 3.3 million players at once. Now about 36,000.
paras: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape by SecretVerse Studio still holds the #2 spot on RBLXSTAT's all-time record list with 3.3 million players at once. On November 21 it had 36,282 playing.
It averaged 93,249 in October, down 45% in a month, even with a Candy and Chocolate update in its name. Speed, it turns out, was not enough.

down.headline: Break and Steal an Egg Gets Scrambled
down.dek: The copycat that grew 2,627% in October is now far from its peak.
paras: Break and Steal an Egg by ILGames x Eggs grew 2,627% in October to a 104,490 average and set a record of 1.3 million players at once. On November 21 it had 56,473 playing, per RBLXSTAT.
Meanwhile the original Steal An Egg just pulled 6.9 million with one turkey. The copy got cracked.

stories.headline: Studio's AI Helpers Get More Keys
stories.dek: Your agent can now set up game passes and read analytics. You decide which doors it opens.
paras: Roblox Creators announced that Studio's MCP capabilities are expanding to Open Cloud. You can use your preferred AI agent to set up developer products and game passes, change game settings, read analytics and import assets.
You choose what the agent can access in each game, and three new Skills teach it how. The robots may now price your game passes. Please check their math.

stories.headline: Your UI Can Sparkle Now
stories.dek: 2D particles land in Studio Beta. Buttons everywhere are about to get very excited.
paras: Roblox Creators announced 2D particles for UI, now in Studio Beta. You can control their speed, drag and spread, then animate color, size and transparency over time.
Roblox pitches it for hit feedback, celebration bursts and ambient sparkle. In other words: every simulator's "+1" pop-up is about to get a lot shinier.

stories.headline: Studio Now Animates From A Prompt
stories.dek: Type what you want, get an R15 animation. Animators: "fine, totally fine."
paras: A new Studio beta lets you generate R15 animations from a text prompt, plus an optional R6 motion rebuilder. It's part of a big wave of AI tools Roblox keeps adding to Studio.
The same week, the Asset Manager got a full release with folders and search, and the minimum draw distance went up to 500 studs, so even low-end phones see more of your map.
